title: Pipe benders and welding positioners
subtitle: Tubend TB 34 / TB 42 mandrel-less pipe benders · WP 100 / WP 300 tilting welding positioners
cover_line: Tubend · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Simple, solid machines for the pipe and welding shop
about_text: Tubend designs and builds bending and forming machinery in Bursa, Turkey. The TB 34 and TB 42 are simple mandrel-less pipe benders with a digital angle readout and a brake motor that holds the bend, and the WP 100 and WP 300 tilting welding positioners turn round parts under the torch at 1 – 5.5 rpm, foot-pedal controlled.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports Tubend machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — tooling chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel on three-phase machines, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
made_in: Made in Turkey by Tubend — with European components
